ideas.title: The Human Cost of the Federal Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the federal funding freeze on vulnerable populations, including those who rely on Medicaid and Medicare.
ideas.angle: Human interest story, exploring the personal stories of those affected by the funding freeze
questions: How many people are affected by the funding freeze?
What are the long-term consequences of this policy?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the human cost of the funding freeze, and to explore the complexities of the issue. It may also reveal potential areas of waste or abuse in the system.
